shellCommands.command: ls -la && cat package.json 2>/dev/null; cat package-lock.json | head -20; node --version; npm --version

(PORT=3456 node server.mjs > /tmp/server.log 2>&1 &) && sleep 1 && \
curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code} %{redirect_url}\n" -X POST -d "title=The+Left+Hand+of+Darkness&author=Ursula+K.+Le+Guin&notes=Winter+on+Gethen." http://localhost:3456/books && \
curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code} %{redirect_url}\n" -X POST -d "title=Piranesi&author=Susanna+Clarke" http://localhost:3456/books && \
ID=$(node -e 'console.log(JSON.parse(require("fs").readFileSync("data/books.json","utf8"))[1].id)') && \
curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code} %{redirect_url}\n" -X POST http://localhost:3456/books/$ID/finish && \
echo "--- restart ---" && pkill -f "node server.mjs"; sleep 0.5; (PORT=3456 node server.mjs >> /tmp/server.log 2>&1 &) && sleep 1 && \
curl -s http://localhost:3456/ | grep -E "books/|Nothing|No finished" && echo "--- book page ---" && \
curl -s http://localhost:3456/books/$ID | grep -E "<h1>|by |Finished|Mark as" ; echo "--- data file ---"; cat data/books.json; pkill -f "node server.mjs"; cat /tmp/server.log

PORT=3456 node server.mjs > /tmp/server.log 2>&1 & PID=$!; sleep 1; \
ID=$(node -e 'console.log(JSON.parse(require("fs").readFileSync("/workspace/data/books.json","utf8"))[1].id)'); \
echo "--- home after restart ---"; curl -s http://localhost:3456/ | grep -E 'href="/books/|Nothing|No finished|finished '; \
echo "--- book page ---"; curl -s http://localhost:3456/books/$ID | grep -E "<h1>|by |Finished|Mark as|textarea"; \
echo "--- 404 ---"; curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}\n" http://localhost:3456/books/nope; \
echo "--- data file ---"; cat /workspace/data/books.json; kill $PID; wait $PID 2>/dev/null; cat /tmp/server.log
